youtube_description:
Jesus... I typed "all good bro" to the boys. Then I sat in my car for twenty minutes. 🚗

He sits in his car outside the office after telling the group chat everything is fine.

He: Jesus... I typed "all good bro" to the boys. Then I sat in my car for twenty minutes. 🚗

Jesus: Your engine was off and your hands were still on the wheel.

He: Everyone thinks I've got it together.

Jesus: Which one of them have you let see the real answer?

He: None. They'd make it awkward.

Jesus: Pick one. One honest sentence is a start.

Jesus: One good word can lift what you've been carrying alone.

“Anxiety weighs down the heart of a man, but a good word cheers it up.”
Proverbs 12:25 (BSB)
